COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   C. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Treat Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision as rumours only.
   C. Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision.

4. Which statement about Intercultural competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural competence.
   B. Say Intercultural competence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Intercultural competence as rumours only.
   D. Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Explain Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Responsible Decision Making is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Responsible Decision Making never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Responsible Decision Making as rumours only.
   C. Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Responsible Decision Making.

7. Which statement about Conflict Resolution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution.
   B. Treat Conflict Resolution as rumours only.
   C. Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Conflict Resolution never happens in Kenya.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

10. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp as rumours only.
   B. Say Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp.
   D. Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
